rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for the area just outside a house entrance, including an ordinary porch.

example.english: We’re sitting on the porch, enjoying the breeze while we wait for you to come back.
example.traditional: 我哋而家坐喺門口吹吓風，等你返嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 co5 hai2 mun4 hau2 ceoi1 haa5 fung1 dang2 nei5 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this for a porch understood specifically as a covered architectural entrance or veranda rather than just the entrance area.

example.english: This house’s porch has a tiled roof, so we don’t have to worry when it rains.
example.traditional: 呢間屋嘅門廊有瓦頂，落雨都唔怕。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 mun4 long4 jau5 ngaa5 deng2 lok6 jyu5 dou1 m4 paa3
